visual.caption: Local achievement companion · save evidence ready

copy.readyBody: A focused local companion for Sons of the Forest achievements, Steam state and optional save evidence.
copy.readyNote: The tracker is read-only. It does not modify game saves, Steam data or Sons of the Forest files.
copy.completeBody: The achievement tracker is installed and ready to read your local Steam state.
copy.removeBody: Remove the Project Island tracker from this PC. Game saves, Steam data and user files remain untouched.
copy.uninstallCompleteBody: Project Island has been removed. Sons of the Forest and its saves were not changed.
